    Location

    Feyrist, behind the teleport next to Gerimor.

    Behaviour

    The Source Of Corruption attacks in melee range. The Source Of Corruption never retreats.

    Strategy

    It's easier to kill it if the blockers trap it in one of the corners of the room. Shooters should be careful because besides its spells, it will also reflect 15% of all the damage dealt to it.
